description:
Replace the ad-hoc, two-contract render pipeline (top-level
`Component.render(state, width) :: [binary]` vs transcript
`Component.render(state, ctx) :: {state, lines, frame_ms}`) and the
hand-stitched `Interactive.build_screen/2` with a single composable,
memoized component model.

Components become functions that return a `%VNode{}` tree. A single
recursive paint phase walks the tree once, writing into a `LineBuf`
(an iodata accumulator with visible-width tracking) — no
`++`/`flat_map`/`List.flatten` in the hot path. Hooks (`use_state`,
`use_memo`, `use_frame`, `use_key`, `use_effect`) provide local
state, memoization, animation, and key handling without bespoke
plumbing per region. OSC 133 zone welding becomes a regular
`%VZone{}` node rather than a post-pass walker. The terminal cursor
becomes a zero-width `%VCursor{}` leaf whose `{row,col}` is stamped
into the buffer and lifted into the renderer's existing
`cursor_seq`. Custom widgets stop escaping the type system through
`{from, %{render: …}}`.

**Design deck (read in full before starting any child ticket):**
`tmp/tui_react_proposal.html` — 15 sections covering today's pain,
goals, the VNode/LineBuf model, component API, hooks, layout,
render walkthrough, cursor-as-VNode, OSC welding, performance
contract, reconciler, extension points, the streaming-Markdown
worked example, migration plan, open questions.

**Project-level guidelines (read at session start):**
- `CLAUDE.md` at repo root.
- Auto-memory entries (`/Users/j5n/.claude/projects/.../memory/MEMORY.md`)
  cover: read the implementation not docs, no `Process.sleep` in
  tests, no silent deviations, multi-head pattern matching over
  top-level `case`, GenServer timeouts via `{:noreply, state, ms}`
  not `Process.send_after`, port tests alongside code.

**Goals:** single contract; nested composition; per-component memo;
single-pass paint; first-class animation; OSC welding via VZone;
mailbox-drain + dirty-aware debounced paint driven by
`UI.State.next_wait_ms/1`.

**Non-goals:** no DOM diff in the React sense; no JSX/sigils in v1;
no global stores; lines remain the output unit; the extension
loader/discovery side stays in `octo_pi_coder` (only the UI
plumbing is in scope here, see d06.16).

**Sequencing.** The codebase stays bilingual throughout: a
`OctoPi.TUI.Compat` adapter wraps any legacy
`Component.render(state, width) :: [binary()]` as a `%VLines{}` leaf
until every region is converted. The order is:
  1. Foundation: d06.1 (VDom core + Compat), d06.2 (reconciler),
     d06.7 (cursor), d06.12 (Text/TruncatedText helpers).
  2. Conversions in parallel: d06.3 (transcript wiring),
     d06.4 (Header/Footer/Loader/Banner), d06.5 (composites),
     d06.10 (Markdown), d06.9 (AssistantMessage),
     d06.11 (Input), d06.13 (dialogs), d06.14 (selectors).
  3. Integration: d06.6 (Screen root replaces build_screen/2).
  4. Audit & cleanup: d06.15 (verify zero legacy), d06.8 (delete
     Compat).
  5. Follow-on: d06.16 (Coder.Extensions.UI).

Dependency edges in the ticket graph encode this. Each child
ticket is self-contained: no cross-context required, every
description names the files to read first and the exit
criteria.
title: TUI: React-style functional component system (VDom → LineBuf)
